title: TREAS-Misc: catch-all vault pile for jewellery the metal piles cannot take (z111)
description: Free floor east of TREAS-Silver on z111, x104-108 y95-98 (x103 left open as a walkway). Holds non-metal jewellery (wood, bone, shell, horn, tooth) and artifact pieces of ore stone that no TREAS pile accepts. Filters are set afterwards with the stockpile settings tool.

phases.label: TREAS-Misc: finished goods in bins, x104-108 y95-98

manual_steps: After placing, run the stockpile tool on TREAS-Misc: finished_goods_types the seven jewellery types, finished_goods_materials ["ILMENITE","SCHIST"], finished_goods_other_materials true.
Undo: run this blueprint with undo=true.
